summary: DrainIterator::next recursively calls itself when entering parent nodes. While scanning subtrees without yielding a matching leaf, recursive frames accumulate across visited subtrees, potentially overflowing the stack even in a balanced tree. The fix replaces recursion with a labeled loop continuation, retaining traversal state in node_stack. Blocked: the fix adds no regression test, and inspection of existing drain/removal tests, including algorithm::removal::test::test_drain_iterator, found no test demonstrating the stack overflow. No tests were executed.
